notes: Scheduling is quick and hands-off: posts go out fast, you can queue another account's schedule while one is posting, and a panel on the left shows live progress from any page. Video previews now load on every account, and on Mac the app opens in its own window with the Remixa icon.
_urls: urls are GitHub Release assets (stable, public, direct .exe/.dmg) and sha256 pins the exact binary - the 2.9.8+ updater verifies the download against it before offering to install. Assets use customer-friendly names (Remixa-Windows.exe / Remixa-Mac.dmg); the release TAG carries the version. Mac dmg is signed + notarized + stapled (no Gatekeeper warning) from the cloud-Mac CI. Both platforms current as of 2.9.49.
